turns.doctor_question: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?
turns.patient_response:
Hi, doctor. It's really nice to meet you too. Thank you so much for taking the time to see me. 

Um... I guess I'm here because... well, I hope I'm in the right place for this, but mostly I just don't really feel like myself anymore. It's a little embarrassing to admit, honestly, and I really don't want you to think I'm just being lazy. But I've sort of stopped doing the things I usually do. I used to be pretty active—I'd go hiking, I was coaching, playing my guitar... but I just stopped all of it. I haven't even been calling people back lately. 

It sounds bad, I know, but some days I just sit in my small rental for hours. I know there are things I need to do, I'm completely aware of it, but I just... I can't seem to make myself start. I hope it's okay that I came in for that. Does that make sense?
